Title: Platform foundation and secure network
Description: Build the hub-and-spoke network, private DNS, firewall, Bastion, and shared security services.
Acceptance Criteria: Hub and spokes deployed; private DNS resolves; firewall egress logged; no public data plane.

Title: Identity and least-privilege access
Description: Implement Entra app roles, scopes, groups, managed identities, and pipeline identities.
Acceptance Criteria: Reader/contributor/manager flows tested; no standing Owner; build and release identities separated.

Title: Data and event-driven processing
Description: Provide Azure SQL, Managed Redis, Blob, Service Bus, and Functions for the logistics domain.
Acceptance Criteria: Transactional order + outbox works; event reaches Function; DLQ monitored.

Title: Logistics API
Description: Implement inventory and order APIs with authentication, authorization, ownership, and audit.
Acceptance Criteria: Both route groups work end to end; negative tests pass.

Title: Infrastructure as code and configuration management
Description: Provision with Terraform and configure with Ansible using secure remote state.
Acceptance Criteria: Terraform plan/apply repeatable; Ansible idempotent; state locked and private.

Title: CI/CD and software supply chain
Description: Build and release the platform with separate pipelines, identities, and approvals.
Acceptance Criteria: Build green; release gated; image scanned and digest recorded.

Title: Observability and security operations
Description: Centralize logs, metrics, traces, alerts, Defender, and incident runbooks.
Acceptance Criteria: Dashboards and alerts exist; a failed request can be traced end to end.

Title: Documentation and handover
Description: Make the platform repeatable by another engineer.
Acceptance Criteria: README, ADRs, runbook, demo script, and cleanup steps are complete.

Title: Hub-and-spoke network
Description: Hub with firewall/Bastion/DNS, ingress/workload/data/management spokes, peering and UDRs.
Acceptance Criteria: Traffic paths validated; no unintended spoke-to-spoke access.

Title: Private DNS and private endpoints
Description: Private endpoint zones for APIM, App Service, SQL, Redis, Blob, Key Vault, Service Bus, ACR, AKS.
Acceptance Criteria: All data services resolve to private IPs from workload and management VNets.

Title: Entra app roles and scopes
Description: Create logistics-api registration, roles, scopes, groups, and client apps.
Acceptance Criteria: Tokens contain expected roles/scopes; negative tests pass.

Title: Managed identities and pipeline identities
Description: Create workload identities and scoped build/release identities with federation.
Acceptance Criteria: No secrets in pipeline; build cannot deploy; release cannot push.

Title: Transactional data model
Description: Design inventory, orders, order lines, outbox, and idempotency tables.
Acceptance Criteria: Schema supports concurrency, ownership, and outbox in one transaction.

Title: Eventing and Functions
Description: Define Service Bus topics/subscriptions and Functions consumers.
Acceptance Criteria: Order event reaches Function; poison message goes to DLQ.

Title: Inventory API
Description: Read and write inventory with manager-only delete.
Acceptance Criteria: Reader/contributor/manager tests pass; deletes audited.

Title: Orders API
Description: Create, read, update, cancel, and manager-delete orders with ownership.
Acceptance Criteria: Users see only their orders; manager can delete with audit.

Title: Terraform modules and remote state
Description: Create reusable network, data, AKS, APIM, and identity modules with Blob backend.
Acceptance Criteria: Plan/apply repeatable; state private and locked.

Title: Ansible baseline
Description: Harden agent/Ansible VMs and apply Kubernetes namespaces, quotas, and network policies.
Acceptance Criteria: Second run reports no changes; baseline enforced.

Title: Build pipeline
Description: Build, test, scan, sign/digest, and publish artifacts without deploy rights.
Acceptance Criteria: Green build; SBOM; image in ACR; build identity cannot deploy.

Title: Release pipeline
Description: Plan/apply infrastructure, configure, migrate, deploy, verify, and roll back.
Acceptance Criteria: Dev deployed; prod approval gate; rollback documented.

Title: Monitoring and alerts
Description: Dashboards, SLO alerts, diagnostic settings, Defender, and runbooks.
Acceptance Criteria: Key alerts fire in a test; trace shows API to SQL path.

Title: Runbook and handover
Description: Document deploy, rollback, restore, rotate, replay, and cleanup.
Acceptance Criteria: Another engineer can follow the runbook without tribal knowledge.

Title: Design hub-and-spoke CIDR plan
Description: Define VNets, subnets, AKS service/pod CIDRs, on-prem ranges, and App Service worker range avoidance.
Acceptance Criteria: CIDR table has no overlaps; each subnet has purpose/size/owner; design reviewed.

Title: Define RBAC matrix and manager delete
Description: Map endpoints to roles, ownership rules, and manager-only deletes.
Acceptance Criteria: Matrix covers all endpoints and includes negative tests for reader/contributor/manager.

Title: Threat model and zero-trust controls
Description: Run STRIDE and map preventive/detective controls.
Acceptance Criteria: At least 10 threats with controls; attack paths reviewed.

Title: Scaffold repo, branch protection, and secret scan
Description: Create GitHub repo, protections, VS Code settings, and pre-commit.
Acceptance Criteria: Repo pushed; main protected; gitleaks clean; prerequisites script run.

Title: Create Azure Boards sprint and backlog
Description: Create Agile project, area, Sprint 1, and import backlog.
Acceptance Criteria: Board has epics/features/stories/tasks and WIP limits.

Title: Bootstrap Terraform state
Description: Create private state storage with versioning, soft delete, Entra auth, and lease locking.
Acceptance Criteria: Remote backend works; no public access; release identity can read/write.

Title: Build hub network and firewall
Description: Deploy hub VNet, firewall, Bastion, gateway, DNS resolver, route tables, NSGs.
Acceptance Criteria: Hub applied; egress logged; Bastion access works; no public SSH.

Title: Apply policy and shared security
Description: Assign Azure Policy, Log Analytics, Key Vault, budget, and diagnostic settings.
Acceptance Criteria: Policy compliance visible; budget alert active; logs flowing.

Title: Deploy AKS private cluster
Description: Create private AKS with CNI Overlay, network policy, workload identity, internal ingress.
Acceptance Criteria: Nodes Ready; no public IP; ACR pull works; APIM can reach ingress.

Title: Deploy APIM and App Gateway
Description: Create APIM Standard v2 with private endpoint/outbound integration and App Gateway WAF_v2.
Acceptance Criteria: APIM private; App Gateway reaches it; 401 without token; WAF blocks test payload.

Title: Deploy data services and private endpoints
Description: SQL, Managed Redis, Blob, Key Vault, Service Bus with private endpoints and DNS.
Acceptance Criteria: Private DNS resolves; public access disabled; identities assigned.

Title: Configure Ansible baseline
Description: Harden VMs and apply Kubernetes namespaces, quotas, network policies, and RBAC.
Acceptance Criteria: Second run reports no changes; baseline verified.

Title: Implement inventory endpoints
Description: GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE inventory with roles, validation, and audit.
Acceptance Criteria: Reader/contributor/manager tests pass; delete audited.

Title: Implement order endpoints and ownership
Description: Create/read/update/cancel/delete orders with own-order rule.
Acceptance Criteria: User A cannot read user B; manager can delete; tests pass.

Title: Implement outbox relay and Functions
Description: Write outbox in transaction; relay publishes; Function consumes and audits.
Acceptance Criteria: Event flows; retry works; DLQ tested.

Title: Build container and publish artifacts
Description: Build, scan, SBOM, digest, push to ACR, publish Helm/artifacts.
Acceptance Criteria: Image digest recorded; scans pass; build identity cannot deploy.

Title: Create release pipeline with approvals
Description: Terraform plan/apply, Ansible, migrations, deploy, smoke, DAST, prod gate.
Acceptance Criteria: Dev deployed; prod blocked on approval; rollback works.

Title: Add observability, alerts, and runbook
Description: Dashboards, alerts, runbook, restore test, cost review, cleanup.
Acceptance Criteria: Alerts tested; trace visible; runbook and cleanup recorded.

Title: Validate no CIDR overlaps
Description: Check VNets, on-prem, AKS service/pod CIDRs, and App Service worker ranges.
Acceptance Criteria: No overlap; documented in network design.

Title: Run gitleaks and pre-commit
Description: Scan the repo before the first push.
Acceptance Criteria: No secrets; hooks installed; failures fixed.

Title: Test private DNS resolution
Description: Run nslookup/dig from workload and management VNets.
Acceptance Criteria: All private endpoints resolve to private IPs.

Title: Test negative auth cases
Description: No token, wrong audience, expired, missing role, other user's order.
Acceptance Criteria: Expected 401/403/404; tests in CI.

Title: Test WAF and APIM policies
Description: Blocked payload, rate limit, no token, valid token without role.
Acceptance Criteria: Expected 403/429/401; logs show rule IDs.

Title: Perform rollback dry run
Description: Helm rollback and App Service slot swap back.
Acceptance Criteria: Previous version restored; smoke tests pass.

Title: Run cost review and cleanup
Description: Review top costs, delete non-prod, verify no orphans.
Acceptance Criteria: Budget within plan; no orphan public IPs/disks.

Title: Record demo and handover
Description: Capture auth, RBAC, event, logs, pipeline, rollback.
Acceptance Criteria: Demo script and evidence stored; README updated.
